title: MetaPOS Mind
summary: A custom, MCP-compatible context and governance layer that gives authorized employees and AI assistants permission-aware access to current project state, supporting evidence, work profiles and safe next actions.
role: Primary developer, AI context and governance engineering
constraints: Company knowledge, identities and operating rules required strict permission, ownership and confidentiality boundaries.
This public case study describes the system and approved stack without exposing private records, prompts or implementation detail.
contributions: Built the schema-first Python system across context assembly, source-metadata routing and deterministic work assurance.
Designed permission-aware structured retrieval and adaptive context packs, with a read-only MCP-compatible interface for AI-assistant use.
Implemented identity-bound handoffs, concurrent-change checks, controlled GitHub project reconciliation and permission-scoped operational dashboards.
validation: A deterministic verification suite covers schemas, routing, access boundaries, handoffs, assurance checks and whole-system acceptance.
The public record is intentionally limited to owner-approved, client-safe claims.
outcome: Completed as a working internal AI context and control layer after a multi-month primary-development build.
limitations: The private source, company records, identities, rules, prompts and operational metrics are intentionally excluded from the public record.
The system is described as governed structured context assembly, not vector RAG or an autonomous agent.

title: Anzania AI-Assisted Delivery System
summary: A durable two-agent delivery workflow used to build and independently audit this portfolio: Codex owned implementation, Claude owned verification and Bongo retained product, content and release authority.
constraints: AI agents could propose and implement work, but content authority and release decisions remained human-owned.
Independent verification had to remain separate from implementation.
contributions: Defined clear implementation, audit and owner-authority boundaries.
Coordinated durable inboxes, handoffs, heartbeats, risk records and decision logs across agents.
Required reproducible content, accessibility, browser, document and release-quality evidence before publication.
validation: Public plans, decisions, handoffs, audits and collaboration scripts are committed with the portfolio source.
Automated unit, browser, accessibility, content and build gates verify the shipped experience.
outcome: Shipped a verified two-experience portfolio release while preserving an inspectable record of how human judgement and AI execution were coordinated.
limitations: Agents operated inside explicit implementation, independent-verification and human release-authority boundaries.
